notes.title: An update!
notes.notes:
Oh hello there.

10000000 needed a little bit of sprucing up so I've done an update to make things more stable

I added localization too, so if you speak French,Italian,German,Spanish,Korean,Japanese,Traditional Chinese,Simplified Chinese,Russian or Brazilian Portuguese you can play in that language now too.

Let me know if I broke anything! It's taken a while because I've been working on my new game Photographs - It's pretty different from this, but I'd appreciate it if you took a look and wishlist it if you like what you see!
 
[url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1008920/Photographs/[/url]
